    cin >> n;

    for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++) cin >> a[i];
    for(int i = 0; i < 3; i++) cin >> b[i];

    int maxWins = min(a[0], b[1]) + min(a[1], b[2]) + min(a[2], b[0]);

    int leftover = 0;
    if(a[0] >= b[0] + b[2]) {

    } else {
        lose += a[0];
        leftover = b[0] + b[2] - a[0];
    }
    int scissorsleft = 0;
    int provide = min(b[0], leftover);
    if(provide >= a[1]) {
        lose += a[1];
        leftover -= a[1];
        scissorsleft = b[1];
    } else {
        lose += provide;
        leftover -= provide;
        int need = a[1] - provide;
        if(b[1] >= need) {
            scissorsleft = b[1] - need;
            lose += need;
        } else {
            lose += b[1];
        }
    }
    lose += min(a[2], scissorsleft + min(leftover, b[2]));

    int minWins = n - lose;
    cout << minWins << " " << maxWins << endl;
    return 0;
}
